findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: score_page_citation, compare_citations, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, get_feedback_reply · Private data: audit_site, score_page_citation, compare_citations, audit_page, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, audit_ai_search · Public sink: compare_citations, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: score_page_citation, compare_citations, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, get_feedback_reply · Private data: audit_site, score_page_citation, compare_citations, audit_page, local_ai_readiness, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, audit_ai_search · Public sink: compare_citations, check_ai_instructions, generate_ai_instructions, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
